Crystal division and PLL multiplication
Integer division: output = crystal / N (N >= 1 and must be a positive integer); period T = 1/f
PLL: VCO frequency = crystal / pre-divider x multiplier M (pre-divider, output divider and M are all positive integers); output = VCO / output divider
Target matching: ideal divider ratio = crystal/target; if the ratio is >= 1 use integer division N = round(crystal/target), if the ratio is < 1 use integer multiplication M = round(target/crystal); error = |actual output - target|/target x 100%
